claims.claim: Complete engine for Toyota vehicles like SUVs and Crossovers
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a used car engine accessory/pulley area, but do not show Toyota branding, engine family, or completeness (missing/attached components not confirmed).
No readable make/model/engine code or VIN/engine number is shown in the witness report.
Photos show grime/oxidation and do not show import documents, labels, or provenance.
Witness report only shows engine close-ups; no start/run video, no fault-code scan, and no running condition evidence.
No audio/video of engine running is included in the witness report.
Mileage is not readable/visible in the photos provided.
Photos show dust/grease and oxidation but do not confirm whether the engine has been opened (no gasket/fastener evidence described).

risks.risk: Engine make/model/variant may not be Toyota RAV4 XA20 (or may be a different Toyota engine family), which affects compatibility and resale value in Lagos.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine code/label (engine block stamping or ID plate) and/or a readable VIN/engine number close-up, plus a photo showing the full engine assembly (front-to-back) to confirm variant.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified used engine assembly with accessories/pulleys only, with compatibility risk.

risks.risk: “Complete engine” may be incomplete (missing key components like alternator, starter, sensors, intake/exhaust parts, wiring harness sections, or timing-related components).
risks.proof: A full set of photos showing the entire engine from multiple angles including: intake side, exhaust side, timing cover area, all sensors/connectors, and a checklist photo of included parts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed complete; treat as missing/unknown parts risk.

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” is not evidenced; the engine may have internal or mechanical faults not visible in static photos.
risks.proof: A short video of the engine starting and idling (cold start if possible), plus an OBD scan screenshot showing no active fault codes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: may need repairs).

risks.risk: Condition may be worse than claimed: photos show heavy grime/grease, oxidation/corrosion on metal surfaces, and rust-stained components—could indicate long storage or neglected maintenance.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of critical areas (oil pan, valve cover gasket edges, timing cover area, coolant passages) and a photo of oil condition (drain sample or dipstick close-up).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown maintenance history and potential corrosion/contamination.

risks.risk: Mileage claim cannot be verified; low mileage could be inaccurate, affecting expected lifespan.
risks.proof: A readable odometer/vehicle mileage record from the donor vehicle or documentation, or a clear engine ID that ties to a known mileage source.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown mileage (worst case: typical used wear).

risks.risk: “Tokunbo direct from Belgium” may be a sales story; without documents, it could be locally sourced or previously repaired.
risks.proof: Photos/scans of import documents (bill of lading/entry papers) or a clear label/marking consistent with Belgium import, plus service/inspection paperwork if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price without provenance premium (worst case: no documentation).

risks.risk: Transmission compatibility is unknown; if the seller is offering engine-only vs engine+gearbox, buyer fitment and cost change.
risks.proof: Photos showing whether gearbox is included (bellhousing connection, gearbox code plate) and confirmation of drivetrain type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine-only/unknown compatibility unless gearbox inclusion is clearly shown.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine code/ID plate and any stamped engine number (readable).
Video of the engine starting and idling (with audio) showing no knock, plus OBD scan screenshot (no active fault codes).
Full photos of the entire engine assembly to confirm it is truly complete (intake/exhaust sides, sensors, wiring harness sections, timing cover area).
Photo of oil dipstick/dipstick reading and/or oil drain condition; include any visible leaks.
If claiming RAV4 XA20 specifically: show the donor vehicle details or documentation tying the engine code to that model.
Confirm whether gearbox is included; provide photos of the bellhousing/gearbox connection and gearbox code plate if present.
response.reason: The witness confirms a used engine accessory/pulley assembly with heavy grime/oxidation, but cannot verify the seller’s key compatibility and working claims (Toyota/RAV4 XA20, complete status, tested/working, mileage). Without proof shots like readable engine code and start/OBD evidence, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
